appearance.extreme: A heavy muscular tail longer than they are tall, ending in a horned knot of bone. It is holding a drink. They are not looking at it.
appearance.obvious: A thick tail as long as their leg, moving with obvious intent, keeping their balance as they turn.
appearance.subtle: Their coat hangs badly at the back.

description: A long muscular tail that does what a hand does, and reaches where a hand cannot. You stopped noticing you were using it about a week in.
drawbacks: Trousers have to be made for you
name: Prehensile Tail
